第563章 林墨不求高位仍掌钦天监（第1页）
新帝登基，尊林墨为帝师，并赐予了“位列三公之上”、“入朝不趋”、“赞拜不名”、“佩剑上殿”等一系列令人炫目的特权。这道圣旨，将林墨的声望和地位，推向了前所未有的巅峰。朝野上下，无数双眼睛都在盯着林墨，猜测着他会如何利用这滔天的权势。
然而，林墨接下来的举动，却让所有人大跌眼镜。
在接受帝师封号的次日早朝，林墨身着朝服，手持玉笏，出班奏道：“陛下，臣有本奏。”
新帝坐在龙椅上，看着自己最信任的老师，温言道：“帝师请讲。”
林墨朗声道：“陛下隆恩，册封臣为帝师，并赐臣诸多殊荣。臣感激涕零，铭感五内。然，臣思虑再三，窃以为，这些殊荣，臣实不敢当。”
此言一出，满朝哗然。所有人都以为林墨会欣然接受这些荣耀，却没想到他竟然会主动推辞。
新帝也是微微一怔，问道：“帝师何出此言？朕所赐，皆乃帝师应得之物。莫非帝师觉得，朕的封赏，还不够厚重？”
林墨摇了摇头，正色道：“陛下误会了。陛下的封赏，重于泰山。然，臣以为，臣之所学，在于天文历法，在于风水堪舆，在于格物致知。臣之志趣，在于观测天象，修订历法，造福百姓。若让臣居于高位，每日纠缠于繁杂的政务和礼仪之中，反而会让臣荒废了本职，辜负了陛下的信任。”
他顿了顿，语气更加恳切：“臣斗胆，恳请陛下收回‘位列三公之上’、‘入朝不趋’等殊荣。臣愿保留‘帝师’之名，以时刻警醒自己，不忘陛下教诲之恩。但臣之实职，仍愿为钦天监监正。臣只想在钦天监中，继续臣未竟的事业——进一步完善《承风历》，并培养更多精通天文历法的后继之才。”
林墨的这番话，让整个朝堂都陷入了沉默。所有人都没想到，在这权力更迭的关键时刻，林墨不仅没有趁机攫取更多的权力，反而主动放弃了那些令人艳羡的特权，选择回到那个相对清冷的钦天监，继续做他的老本行。
新帝听完林墨的奏请，沉默了良久。他看着林墨那双清澈而坚定的眼睛，仿佛看到了当年那个在青阳县，不畏强权、秉公断案的年轻官吏。这么多年过去了，经历了无数的风雨和诱惑，林墨的那颗初心，依然没有改变。
新帝的心中，涌起一股深深的敬意。他站起身，对着林墨，郑重地点了点头：“帝师**亮节，朕，佩服！朕准了！帝师仍领钦天监监正之职，总领天下天文历法事宜。至于‘帝师’之名，乃朕对老师的一片心意，还望老师勿要再推辞。”
林墨见新帝已经让步，也不再坚持，当即叩首谢恩：“臣，领旨谢恩！”
这场朝堂上的风波，就这样平息了。林墨主动放弃高位，仍掌钦天监的消息传出后，在京城引起了不小的议论。有人说林墨傻，放着大权不握，却要去摆弄那些枯燥的仪器和数字。也有人说林墨精，知道功高震主的道理，主动避嫌，以求自保。
但无论外人如何议论，林墨都不为所动。他脱下那身象征着高官厚禄的朝服，换上了自己熟悉的便装，回到了钦天监那熟悉的环境中。当他再次站在观星台上，仰望那片浩瀚的星空时，他的心中，充满了前所未有的平静和踏实。他知道，这里，才是真正属于他的天地。

Chapter 563 Lin Mo does not seek a high position but still controls the Heavenly Prison (page 1)
The new emperor ascended the throne, respected Lin Mo as his imperial master, and bestowed upon him a series of dazzling privileges such as "ranking above the three princes", "entering the court without any tendency", "praising and worshiping without being named", and "going to the palace with a sword". This imperial edict pushed Lin Mo's reputation and status to an unprecedented peak. Countless pairs of eyes in both the government and the public were staring at Lin Mo, speculating on how he would use this huge power.
However, Lin Mo's next move surprised everyone.
On the morning of the next morning after receiving the title of Imperial Master, Lin Mo, dressed in court attire and holding a jade scepter, came out of the class and said: "Your Majesty, I have this memorial."
The new emperor sat on the dragon chair, looked at his most trusted teacher, and said warmly: "Master, please speak."
Lin Mo said loudly: "Your Majesty, with great kindness, conferred upon me the title of Imperial Master, and granted me many honors. I am so grateful that I am filled with tears of gratitude. However, I have thought about it over and over again, and I secretly believe that I really do not deserve these honors."
As soon as this statement came out, the whole court was in an uproar. Everyone thought that Lin Mo would happily accept these honors, but they did not expect that he would actively refuse.
The new emperor was also slightly startled and asked: "Why did the emperor say this? All the gifts I gave him were what the emperor deserved. Could it be that the emperor felt that my reward was not generous enough?"
Lin Mo shook his head and said seriously: "Your Majesty has misunderstood. Your Majesty's rewards are more important than Mount Tai. However, I think that what I have learned lies in astronomy and calendar, in geomantic omen, and in studying things to gain knowledge. My ambition is to observe celestial phenomena, revise calendars, and benefit the people. If I were to occupy a high position and be entangled in complicated government affairs and etiquette every day, I would have neglected my duties and betrayed Your Majesty's trust."
He paused and said in a more sincere tone: "I have the courage to ask your Majesty to take back the honors of 'ranking above the three princes' and 'unfailing in entering the court.' I would like to keep the name of 'Emperor's Master' so that I can always alert myself and not forget the grace of His Majesty's teachings. However, for my actual duties, I am still willing to serve as a supervisor for Qin Tian Jian. I just want to continue my unfinished business in Qin Tian Jian - to further improve the "Chengfeng Calendar" and cultivate more successors who are proficient in astronomical calendars."
Lin Mo's words caused the entire court to fall into silence. No one expected that at this critical moment of power change, Lin Mo not only did not take the opportunity to seize more power, but instead took the initiative to give up those enviable privileges and chose to return to the relatively cold Qin Tian Prison to continue his old profession.
The new emperor was silent for a long time after listening to Lin Mo's petition. He looked at Lin Mo's clear and firm eyes, and seemed to see the young official in Qingyang County who was not afraid of power and judged cases impartially. After so many years, and after experiencing countless ups and downs and temptations, Lin Mo's original intention has still not changed.
A deep respect surged in the new emperor's heart. He stood up, faced Lin Mo, and nodded solemnly: "I admire the Emperor's integrity, I admire you! I'm right! The Emperor still holds the post of Imperial Heavenly Supervisor and is in charge of the world's astronomical and calendar matters. As for the name of 'Emperor', it is my whole heart to the teacher, and I hope the teacher will not refuse it again."
Lin Mo saw that the new emperor had given in and no longer persisted. He immediately kowtowed and thanked him: "My lord, I accept the order and thank you!"
The turmoil in the court just calmed down. After the news that Lin Mo voluntarily gave up his high position and still took charge of the Tianjian came out, it caused a lot of discussion in the capital. Some people say that Lin Mo is stupid, letting go of power while fiddling with boring instruments and numbers. Some people also say that Lin Mojing knows the principle of high power and shocks the master, and takes the initiative to avoid suspicion in order to protect himself.
But no matter what outsiders say, Lin Mo doesn't care.Moved. He took off the court clothes that symbolized high official status and wealth, put on familiar casual clothes, and returned to the familiar environment of Qin Tian Prison. When he stood on the observatory again and looked up at the vast starry sky, his heart was filled with unprecedented peace and stability. He knew that this was the world that truly belonged to him.
